title: feat(analytics): list_datasets offers candidates for a term that matched nothing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34763

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`list_datasets` 在某个词一个成员都没精确命中时，服务器填 `candidates`：拿这个词和成员的名字、各语言显示名、同义词比"互相包含"（两边都至少 2 个字符），只从这个调用者能看到的数据集和成员里挑，每个词最多 5 个。`list_datasets` 工具说明和 MCP `initialize` 里的选择规则同步写上：有候选就反问用户，不替用户选，也不把候选当命中；没命中也没候选才回退到对象查询。
- **为什么改**：#34691 裁定 F1 B，「零命中返回候选」由服务器给，产品内 AI 和所有 MCP 客户端读到同一份结果。规范形状已随 #34761 落地，本 PR 是执行器和说明文字那一半。
- **风险与回滚**：精确命中规则和 `matches` 一字不改；只在有词零命中且有相近成员时多一个可选键，规范早已声明。说明文字变长：工具说明 1095 → 1414 字节，`initialize` 规则 453 → 741 字节。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts`（`findDatasetTermCandidates`，"相近"规则、命中压制、顺序和上限都在这里）、`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts`（只从已准入成员取候选的那几行，以及 `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION`）、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`（`DATASET_SELECTION_RULE`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/dataset-term-matcher.test.ts src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件 58 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The near-term finder** (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts`, new `findDatasetTermCandidates` beside `matchDatasetTerms`). For each term with no hit in any listed dataset, it returns the members near it as `{ term, dataset, member }`, to the shape, order and cap of `ListDatasetsOutputSchema.candidates` and the ADR-0149 D3 amendment note.
  - **Near (the card's proposal, kept):** after `normalizeDatasetTerm`, one of the member's targets (its `name`, its `label` in every locale of an inline map, each string `synonym`) contains the term, or the term contains the target, with both sides at least two code points long (`DATASET_TERM_NEAR_MIN_CODE_POINTS = 2`). No edit distance, stem or embedding. I measured nothing that argued for another rule: on the showcase it gives exactly the card's `invoice` answer (below).
  - **A hit anywhere suppresses the term.** The hit test is the same `matchedOn` equality that `matchDatasetTerms` reports as `matches`, over the same members, so a term with a `matches` entry anywhere in the answer has no candidate. What counts as a match is unchanged, and the existing equality test (no hit on a substring) is untouched.
  - **Order and cap:** terms in the order sent, datasets in the order listed, each dataset's measures before its dimensions, each in entry order. At most `LIST_DATASETS_MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_TERM` (5) per term, taken from the front, with no marker for the cut. A term sent twice is offered once, since the second copy adds nothing. The spec is silent on repeated terms; this is my choice, and it is pinned.
- **The fill** (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts`, `listDatasets`). The finder runs over the per-dataset `dimensions` / `measures` lists that the catalogue entry is built from. Those are already filtered by `admitDatasetCatalogEntry`, so a withheld member, an `internal`-field member and an unadmitted dataset can never be offered, and every pointer names a member listed in the same answer. `candidates` is set only when the list is non-empty, so the key is absent rather than an empty list.
- **Selection text, route A** (seat amendment 6951344053 on #34686). `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION` and `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` now carry the rows of step 2 in `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`, each in its own sentences:
  - each word for a thing measured that matches exactly one measure is computed, and two such words are two metrics, computed both;
  - one word matching several measures is a question for the user, without picking;
  - a word with `candidates` is the same question, listing each candidate's label, dataset label and description; a candidate is never picked and never treated as a match;
  - no match and no candidates falls back to the object tools, labelled as not from a governed metric.
  The dimension-alone, `membersWithheld`, `provenance`, 非指标口径 and "name the dataset of the fallback object" sentences of the tool description stay.

  | String | Before (bytes, UTF-8) | After | Delta |
  |:--|--:|--:|--:|
  | `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION` | 1095 | 1414 | +319 |
  | `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` | 453 | 741 | +288 |

  Measured by evaluating each string's source expression at base `d947a93c` and at this branch. The rule's docblock above `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` now names the candidates row too (follow-up round, after #34881 landed; see below).
- **Docs that quote the rule:** `packages/mcp/README.md` (the `initialize` instructions section) and `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` (Governed metrics and the `initialize` instructions) carry the same four rows.
- **Checklist:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json` `ai.mcp-dataset-tools` moves to revision 3. It gains a near-miss step (`terms: ['invoice']`, then `['invoices']`) and a matching clause. The description clause now names the candidates row, the `qa_no_word` clause adds "no `candidates` key", and `automated.ref` names the candidate pins. New step and clause are appended, so earlier indices do not move. The checklist README names no generator; `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green and wrote nothing.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34763-list-datasets-candidates-fill.md`. `@objectstack/service-analytics` and `@objectstack/mcp` are both `patch`, because `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). `Clause-②: no`.

Outside the claimed surface: none. Every file is inside the claim's file surface.

## Tests

- `src/__tests__/dataset-term-matcher.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe('findDatasetTermCandidates')` with 6 tests. They cover:
  - both containment directions (`金额` near `合同金额`, `合同金额` near `金额`), with name, label locale and synonym targets after normalization;
  - the two-code-point floor on each side, plus the two-code-point positive control;
  - a hit in another dataset suppresses the term while the other terms still get candidates;
  - order: terms as sent, datasets as given, measures before dimensions even when the dimension is declared first;
  - the cap of 5 per term from the front, counted per term, with every entry a bare `{ dataset, member, term }` pointer;
  - a repeated term, empty terms and no datasets.
- `src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe('[#34763] …')` with 4 tests over the plugin-wired service and the security double. They cover:
  - the restricted caller `u_me`: only `rev` → `pipeline.measures.revenue` is offered. Nothing is offered for `secret` (an internal-field member), `rate` or `marg` (members over the unreadable `margin`), or `tot` (in `locked_ds`, which `u_me` may not query, and in `closed_ds`, which is not API-exposed). Nothing is offered for `营收` either, because it matched.
  - the admin: more is offered by the same rule, and `closed_ds` and `secret_sum` never appear;
  - `margin`, which equals `margin_total`'s label, gets no candidate although `margin_rate` contains it; the control `marg` is offered both;
  - the key is absent for no terms, for all-matched terms, and when nothing readable is near.
  Every candidate is checked to resolve to a member listed in the same answer, and the answer parses under `ListDatasetsOutputSchema`.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe('[#34763] list_datasets candidates pass through MCP unchanged')` with 3 tests (folded in during the follow-up round; first landed as a separate file):
  - the fixtures are spec-valid;
  - `candidates` passes through `tools/call list_datasets` unchanged, with the same entries in the same order and nothing added;
  - an answer without the key comes back without it.
- `packages/mcp/src/initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts` pins only that the rule names both tools, not its wording, so it needed no change and is untouched.

- **Per-term cap.** Anchor `if (++offered >= LIST_DATASETS_MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_TERM) break scan;` replaced by `++offered;`. On-disk proof: anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `85170dd7` → `85f8238f`. Result: `Tests 1 failed | 57 passed (58)`, and the failing test was `findDatasetTermCandidates > offers at most 5 per term, the first in listing order, with no cut marker`. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`85170dd7`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **A hit suppresses candidates.** Anchor `    if (hit) continue;` replaced by `    void hit;`. On-disk proof: anchor x1 → x0, blob `85170dd7` → `e597fc91`. Result: `Tests 5 failed | 53 passed (58)`. The failing tests were the matcher's "offers nothing for a term with a hit in ANY dataset" and all four `[#34763]` tests in `dataset-tools.test.ts`. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status --porcelain` is empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live reading on the showcase** (the card's acceptance), taken at `2926ce23`. The server was booted with `pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --fresh -p 38763 --no-watch`, against the showcase closure built under the lock. The root `pnpm dev` refused because its prerequisite check wants every package built. An `osk_` key was minted with `POST /api/v1/keys` as the seeded admin, then `tools/call list_datasets` was sent over HTTP MCP. Eight datasets were listed in each answer, and no answer was `partial`.

  ```text
  terms ['invoice']     showcase_invoice_metrics.matches: []   no other entry has a match
                        candidates: [{term:'invoice', dataset:'showcase_invoice_metrics', member:'measures.invoice_count'},
                                     {term:'invoice', dataset:'showcase_invoice_metrics', member:'measures.paid_count'}]
  terms ['invoices']    showcase_invoice_metrics.matches: [{term:'invoices', member:'measures.invoice_count', matchedOn:'label'}]
                        candidates key: absent
  terms ['qa_no_word']  every entry's matches: []               candidates key: absent
  ```

  `paid_count` ("Paid Invoices") is offered beside `invoice_count` because its label contains `invoice`. The same boot served the new `initialize` rule and the new `list_datasets` description over `tools/list`, verbatim as in the source.
- **One candidate vs the skill's last row.** The ADR-0149 D3 amendment note and the seat's route A say a term with candidates is asked about. The published skill's row "Nothing matches, and the listed measures do not offer several readings of the word" sends one near form to step 4 ("One near form is not a match either: it selects nothing"). For a term with exactly one candidate, the tool texts here say ask, and that row says fall back. Both texts agree that the candidate is never acted on; they differ only on whether to ask first. `skills/**` is outside this card. Seat 3 has since ruled that one candidate asks (see the ruling note below).
- **How broad near is, measured.** Containment at two code points is wide on short ASCII terms. In the unit fixture, `tot` reaches `margin_total` ("margin total"), and a two-letter term reaches every target that contains it. The per-term cap of 5 bounds the list. I add no ranking because the spec forbids one.
- The tool-table row for `list_datasets` in `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` does not quote the rule, so it is left as it is (claim: those docs change only where they quote the rule).

## Ruling note: one candidate asks

With a single candidate for a term, the tool description and the `initialize` rule say to ask, as the ADR-0149 D3 amendment note does ("With candidates, the AI asks in rule 3's form and acts on none"). This departs from seat 3's earlier ruling on #34792 (Q1 A, record 6945986942: one loose candidate falls back, labelled), which predates `candidates`. Seat 3 ruled on this PR that the ADR note outranks it. The published skill's row "One near form is not a match either: it selects nothing" is amended under #34868 to ask when `list_datasets` returns a candidate. The MCP pin is now folded into `packages/mcp/src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts` as a top-level describe (AGENTS.md ruling 6583487846); the separate file is deleted.

## Follow-up round

After #34881 landed (`c6ecd1fab8`), this round did four things:

- **Merged `origin/main`** (`c81f498b5f`) as merge `762b721b`, with the trailers on the merge commit. It merged cleanly. #34881's changes to `mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts`, `skill-md.ts` and the `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` docblock all came in as written.
- **Folded the MCP pin** into `packages/mcp/src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts` as a top-level describe with the same 3 tests. It reuses the harness's `makeBridge` and `callTool`. `packages/mcp/src/list-datasets-candidates-34763.test.ts` is deleted, and the checklist's `automated.ref` no longer names it.
- **Updated the docblock.** #34881's docblock above `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` now also says:
  - two words with one measure match each are two metrics, both computed;
  - a word with `candidates` is the same question, listing label, dataset label and description, never a pick and never a match, even for a single candidate;
  - only a word with no match and no candidate falls back, labelled.
  The rule string itself is unchanged from the first round.
- **Checked that the merged tree agrees with "one candidate asks".** I grepped for `near form`, `selects nothing`, `loose form` and `single candidate` across `packages/mcp`, service-analytics, `skills/objectstack-ask` and the docs. The only text that differs is the skill's row "One near form is not a match either: it selects nothing" in `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` and in the generated `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts`. Since #34881, that generated file is what the served `/mcp/skill` text is rendered from. This difference is expected until #34868 amends the skill. The tool description, the `initialize` rule, `packages/mcp/README.md` and `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` all say to ask.
